rows.output: Oliver Cromwell, alága ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell Society, sọ pé: “Ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó ṣeé ṣe nínú ìjíròrò tó wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ nípa yíyí àwọn àwòrán kúrò ní àwọn àwòrán náà pé ìrísí Oliver Cromwell níta ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin Westminster yóò di ibi ìfọkànsìn.
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, alága ti Ẹgbẹ́ Cromwell, sọpé: “Ó jẹ́ ohun tí kò ṣée dènà nínú àríyànjiyàn tó ńlọ lọ́wọ́ nípa ìyọkúrò àwọn èère wípé àwòrán èèrè ti Oliver Cromwell tówà níta Ààfin ti Westminster ni yóò di àfojúsùn kan.

rows.reference: Bóyá Cromwell tó ṣe àṣìṣe náà ni wọn yóò fi rúbọ fún àwọn ìṣe Thomas baba-ńlá rẹ̀ ní àwọn ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún tó saájú.

rows.output: Ìtàn ọlàwọ́ Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft ti Cromwell jẹ́ ẹ̀rí ìmúrasílẹ̀ ọ̀rúndún kọkàndínlógún àti apá kan ìtàn ìtàn ọ̀rọ̀ kan tí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn gbà gbọ́ pé ó ṣì yẹ kí a ṣe ayẹyẹ.
rows.reference: Ìṣátúnfihàn ńlá ti Ọlọ́lajὺlọ́ William Hamo Thorneycroft nípa Cromwell ni ẹ̀rí ti èrò ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún ìkọkàndínlógún àti ara àkọsílẹ̀ ìtàn ẹnikan tí ọ̀pọ̀ eniyan sí gbàgbọ́ wípé ó sì yẹ lẹ́nití a ńṣàjọyọ̀.

rows.output: Ọgbọ́n Ọlọ́gbọ́n náà sọ fún The Sunday Telegraph: “Cromwell ni a kà sí ẹni tí ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn, bóyà ju ní ọ̀rúndún kọkàndínlógún lọ ju báyìí lọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùṣàkóso ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin lọ́dọ̀ ìmúra látita, ìpèníjà rẹ̀ ni ó sì jẹ́ ọba.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Goldsmith sọ fún Sunday Telegraph: “Cromwell ni ọ̀pọ̀ eniyan kàsí, bóyá jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ lópin ọgọ́ọ̀rún ọdún kọkàndínlógún ju òní lọ, gẹ́gẹ́bí olùdáààbó ìgbìmọ̀ aṣojú-ṣofiń kúrò lọ́wọ́ ìnira tó ńwá láti ìta, níti ẹjọ́ tirẹ̀ àní àwọn orí-adé.

rows.reference: Bóyá ìyẹn jẹ ìsàtúnfihàn kan tó péye tí ó sì bójúmu jẹ́ orí ọ̀rọ̀ àríyànjiyàn ìtàn tó ńtẹ̀síwájú.

rows.output: "Nígbà tí ìhalẹ̀mọ́ ìkún omi ńláńlá ti wáyé lánẹ́yìnlá, àwọn ènìyàn ṣì ń ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn ní etíkun, wọ́n kò sì sáré lọ́wọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ wọ́n sì di àwọn olùfarapa.” Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ ìdènà ìṣòro ìṣòro Indonesia BNPB sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní Jakarta.
rows.reference: ''Nigbati ìdúnkoòkò tsunami náà dìde ní àná, àwọn eniyan sì ńṣe iṣẹ́ wọn létíkun tíwọn kòsì sá kuro lójú-ẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì di ẹniti o farakó-áásá,'' ni Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ tó ńrísí díndín ewu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù kù lorilẹ-ede Indonesia BNPB sọ nínú ìfitónilétí kan Jarkata.

rows.output: Ìkún-omi náà kò wá níkan, ó mú àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó sì lu ohun gbogbo tó wà lórí ilẹ̀, ”Nugroho sọ pé, ó sì fi kun pé ìkún-omi náà ti rìnrì nínú òkun tó ṣí sílè ní iyara 800 kph (497 mph) kí ó tó dé etíkun.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà kòwá nípa ara rẹ̀, ó wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀,'' ni Nugroho sọ, tí ó sì fikún un pé ìkún-omi tsunami náà ti rin ìrìn-àjò kọjá gbangba òkun ní àwọn ìwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́sáré kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀jọ̀ ní wákàtí kan (máìlí 497 ní wákàtí kan) kí ó tó kọlu bèbè òkun.

rows.output: Ní àkókò yẹn, Ṣáínà ṣe àfihàní rẹ̀ ní ọdún tó kẹ́yìn: ó ń lépa láti jẹ́ No.1 nínú ìmúṣẹ AI nípa 2030.

rows.output: "Ìdá méjì àwọn ìwádì AI yóò jẹ́ ìbèrè tó dára, níwọ̀n bí gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ti jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lọ́wọ́ U.S., a sì ń wá ìyípadà tó tẹ̀ lé AI," ni Lee sọ.
rows.reference: Lee tunb́o ̣so wipẹ ''Sísọ owò tí a ńyà ṣọ́tọ̀ fún ìwáàdí AI di ìlọ́pòméjì yóò jẹ́ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rere kan, pẹ̀lú wipe àwọn orilẹ-ede miran wà lọ́nà tójìnnà púpọ̀ lẹ́yìn orilẹ-ede U.S., tí àwá sì ńfojú sójú sọ́nà fún àlùyọ tókan ninu AI.

rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lè mú kí àwọn ànfàní pọ̀ sí i pé àṣeyọrí AI tó tóbi jù lọ tó ń bẹ lẹ́yìn yìí yóò ṣe ní U.S., Lee sọ fún CNBC nínú ìfọrọwérọ kan ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: Sísọ ìfúnnilówó dí ìlọ́poméjì leè sọ àwọn ìṣọwọṣéeṣe náà di méjì láti ríi pé àṣeyọrí AI títóbi tókàn ní yóò di ṣíṣe ní orilẹ-ede U.S., gẹgẹ bíi Lee ṣe sọ fún CNBC ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan lọ̣́̀sẹ́ yìí.

rows.output: Lee, ẹni tí ìwé rẹ̀ “AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order” ti jade ní oṣù yìí, jẹ́ CEO ti Sinovation Ventures, tí ó ti ṣe idoko-owo nínú ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ AI tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ ní Ṣáínà, Face++.

rows.reference: Àwọn ìjọba méjèèjì náà ṣe àdéhùn kan ninu oṣù Òkúdu ní ìdúró lórí orúkọ tuntun náà tí wọn dá àbá rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọ orilẹ-ede tójẹ́ alátakò wí àwíjàre pé orúkọ náà yóò dín agbára ìdánimọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀yà Slavic ti Masidóníà tíwọ́n pọ̀ jùlọ kù.

rows.output: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọ pé kò ní dibo nínú ìdìbò náà, àti pé ìpolongo ìdúróṣinṣin ti dá ìdààmú sílẹ̀ nípa bóyá ìdúróṣinṣin tó kéré ju 50% tí a nílò fún ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́wọ́ pé ó wà.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọpé òun kòní dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àtipé ìpolongo fún ìdẹ́yẹsí kan ti jẹ́kí àwọn ìsiyèméjì wà lórí bóyá ìjádedìbò yóò tó ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún eyiti i ṣe iye tó kéré jùlọ tí wọ́n nílò fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ eyiti ó wúlò.

rows.output: Ìbéere lórí ìdìbò náà ka: "Ṣé o fẹ́ ìbọ̀wọ̀ NATO àti ìbọ̀wọ̀ EU pẹ̀lú ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì."
rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.output: Àwọn olùfọwọ́sọ́nà fún orúkọ ìyípadà, títí kan Ààrẹ Zoran Zaev, jẹ́ kí wọ́n sọ pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó tọ́ láti tẹ̀ síwájú nínú ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ sí àwọn ẹgbè bí EU àti NATO fún Mẹ́sìdóníà, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jáde láti inú ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.output: Mo wá lónìí láti dibo fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọmọdé ní Masedóníà kí wọ́n lè máa gbé ní ìdààmú ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí ìgbésí ayé àbójútó fún gbogbo wa,” ni Olivera Georgijevska, 79, sọ ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó tó ti sọ pé wọ́n á tẹ̀ lé abajade ìdìbò náà, èyí sì mú kí ó ní ìtànkálẹ̀.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjìlá nínú mẹ́ta nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìrònú àìtọ́ tí a ti rí ní ọ̀sán.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.output: Bí ó ti wù kí ó rí, ìdìbò náà jẹ́ 16%, ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú 34% nínú ìdìbò ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó kọjá ní ọdún 2016 nígbà tí 66% àwọn tí wọ́n forúkọ sílẹ̀̀dìbò ṣe ìdìbò wọn.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: Mo jade lati dibo nitori awọn ọmọ mi, ibi wa ni Yuroopu," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, oludibo ni olu-ilu, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar Dokoki na Wales suna damuwa da "kama kaman muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs game da shawarar cewa sunan su ya canza zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: An tashi ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a ko'ina cikin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya jawo dariya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "mun damu da cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft kuma pwp yana nufin feces.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani Plaid AM ya ce rukunin a matsayin gaba ɗaya "ba shi da farin ciki" kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu madadin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce, "muna bude tunanin" game da canjin sunan, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tsalle na harshe daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A cikin wannan mahallin haruffan Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u a Yorkshire English.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokar gabatar da canje-canje na sunan, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayani game da abin da ake kira mambobin Majalisar za ta kasance a hannun mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba Majalisar Wales ikon canza sunan ta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani taron jama'a kan shawarwarin da suka samu goyon baya mai fadi na kiran majalisar da majalisar dokoki ta Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan al’amuran sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama’a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɗɓuka, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga yarjejeniyar na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran ya gabatar da kundin tsarin mulki kan canje-canje cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyara za ta hada da wasu canje-canje a yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka'idoji kan cirewar mambobi da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su sami kuri'a ta karshe kan tambayar abin da za su kira lokacin da suka tattauna dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedonians suna kada kuri'a a zaben da za a canza sunan kasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Makedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne a kokarin warware rigingimun da suka dore da makwabta kasar Girka, wadda ke da yanki mai suna Makedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi tsayuwar daka cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan ƙasar ta, kuma ta yi adawa da shawarwarin shiga kungiyar EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shug Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya yi adawa da plebiscite kan canjin sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da kuri'ar.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Sautunan Cocin St. Martin's sun yi shuru yayin da majami'u ke fama da wahala a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "Yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya tana da ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyar daban" in ji.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An yi wa mashahuran barci da wuraren da mutane ke zuwa akai-akai a matsayin dakunan 'yan uwan ​​da ke zaune a cikin unguwanni."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudin da aka samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dade kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammanin ba, "kuma ba da daɗewa ba za su sake komawa inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci-coci, in ji shi, za a iya maye gurbinsa da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidajen da za su cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran majami'un da ke cikin unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawaitar mutanen da ke siyan gidajen haya a cikin wadannan gine-gine za su kasance 'yan fari ne," ya ce, "kuma haka za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u za su rufe gaba daya domin ba zai yiwu da yawa daga cikin wadannan mutane da suka koma wajen gidan haya su zama membobin wadannan majami'u ba."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: An gina duka majami'u da kungiyar fari kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai rinjaye - Cocin Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara goma bayan haka.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Methodist ta farko ta koma a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar bakar fata da suka yi bauta a kusa da su suka karɓi ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An karɓi St. Martin's da wani taron bakar fata a karkashin jagorar Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yunƙurin da ya hada da masu sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan sayar da kayan say
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ya lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da mabiyan Father Johnson ke shirya sake gina shi, sun ba da umarni na carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mallam David Johnson, ɗan Mista Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa "carillon shine agogon talakawa."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya buga carillon a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Kasadar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi mara maye gurbinsa."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta yi wasa da dan wasan Afirka, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsu ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: A cikin watanni da suka gabata, an yi taƙama a St. Martin game da masu gine-gine da masu aikin gini, wasu da limaman cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da bishop din Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Mataimakin limamin cocin - majalisar gudanarwa ta limamin cocin, wanda ya kunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - ya rubuta ga bishop a watan Yuli da damuwar cewa bishop "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsawa kudin" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu gine-gine da masu aikin gini da bishop ya aika ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu masu ibada sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya game da shugabancin diocese.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifi ya raunata yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don lobster a California.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kayan kwalliyar Birtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's yana kalubalantar Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da shagunan kayan ado masu salo na kayan kwalliyar da ma'aikatan masana ke gudanar da su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na ƙoƙari mai yawa zuwa kasuwar kyau ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan gida ke raguwa, manyan sassan kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin ƙasar, kuma a ƙara zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyau yana faruwa ne yayin da manyan kantuna ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin saman da aka yi amfani da su a baya don Talabijin, microwave, da kayan gida.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan ado na sa, har zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.output: Rashin da ake da shi daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees kuma za su sami ƙarin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa lakabi irin waɗanda ake samu a shaguna kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayan abinci kuma yana sake fara samar da layin kayan shafawa na Boutique domin mafi yawan kayayyakin su su zama masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake kara bukata da matasan masu siyayya ke bukata.
rows.reference: Haka kuma babban shagon zai sake ƙaddamar da ranjinsa na kayan zamani saboda mafi yawancin kayayyakin su zama na abotar vegan - wani abin da ke samun ƙaruwar buƙata ga kananan masu yin ciniki.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da parfume, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada kasancewa a cikin shaguna na Sainsbury, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, a makon da ya gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekarar.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Siyan kan layi da kuma sauya sheka zuwa siyan ƙananan adadi na abinci a kowace rana a cikin shagunan da ke kusa da su yana nufin dole ne manyan shagunan abinci su yi ƙarin ƙoƙari don shawo kan mutane su ziyarta.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.output: Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury's, ya ce, shagunan za su yi kama da manyan shaguna yayin da kamfanin supermarket ke kokarin yaki da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da karin ayyukan da ba na abinci ba.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, shugaban Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan gefen za su ci gaba da zama kamar manyan shaguna masu ɓangarori kamar yadda jerin babban shagon ke ƙoƙarin gasa da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl tare da karin ayyuka da wanda ba na abinci ba.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya kasance yana sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗakunan sayar da kayan a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ya gabatar da wasu wuraren Habitat tun lokacin da ya sayi duka jerin biyu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya ƙara sayar da abinci da kuma saɓan sayar da kayan.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana sa wuraren sayarwa na gefe na Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna haka kuma ya gabatar da wasu Habitats tun da ya saye gaba ɗaya jerinsu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda yake cewa ya ƙara inganta cinikayyar kayan abinci inda kuma ya sa samun ya zama mai riba.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayan abinci na baya ya yi ƙoƙarin sake fasalin sassa na kayan ado da na magani, amma ya kare a gazawa.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin da babban shagon ya yi na da a farfaɗo da ɓangarorin kwalliyar da magunguna ya ƙare babu nasara.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ta gwada haɗin gwiwa tare da Boots a farkon 2000s, amma haɗin gwiwar ya ƙare bayan wata muhawara kan yadda za a raba kudin shagunan magani a cikin shagunan su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya gwada wani haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci tare da Boots a farkon shekaru na 2000, amma haɗuwar ta zo ƙarshe a bayan wani rikici na yadda za a raba kuɗaɗen da ke shigowa daga shagunan magani a cikin manyan shagunan nasa.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na asibiti 281 ga Celesio, mai mallakar Lloyds Pharmacy, kan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.

rows.output: An ce Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar ƙara nau'ikan kayan kula da fata na alatu da suka hada da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.

rows.output: Bayan girgizar kasa ta Lombok, misali, an gaya wa kungiyoyin kasa da kasa na waje ba su da bukatar.
rows.reference: A bayan girgizar ƙasa ta Lombok, ga misali, an ce wa ƙungiyoyin ƙasashen waje da ba na gwamnati ba cewa ba a buƙatarsu.

rows.output: Kodayake sama da kashi 10 cikin 100 na al'ummar Lombok sun rasa matsugunansu, ba a bayyana bala'in kasa ba, wanda ya zama dole don kara karfafa taimakon kasa da kasa.

rows.output: "A cikin yawancin lokuta, abin takaici, sun bayyana a sarari cewa ba sa neman taimakon kasa da kasa, don haka yana daɗe," in ji Misis Sumbung.
rows.reference: “A misalai da yawa, abin takaici, sun nuna a fili cewa ba sa neman taimako na ƙasa-da-ƙasa, don haka wani abu ne mai ƙan ƙalubale,” inji Misis Sumbung.

rows.output: Yayin da Save the Children ke tattara tawagar da za ta tafi Palu, har yanzu ba a taba tabbatar da ko ma’aikatan kasashen waje za su iya aiki a kasa ba.

rows.output: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar bala'o'i ta kasa, ya ce jami'an Indonesia suna duba halin da ake ciki a Palu don sanin ko za a bada izinin hukumomin kasa da kasa su taimaka wajenar da bala'in.
rows.reference: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar haɗura ta ƙasa, ya ce jami’an Indonesiya suna auna yanayin na cikin Palu don ganin ko za a bari wakilan ƙasa-da-ƙasa su ba da gudunmawa ga ƙoƙarin tallafi.

rows.output: A cikin yanayin girgizar ƙasa da Indonesia ke fuskantar akai-akai, ƙasar tana cikin haɗari mai tsanani don fushin yanayi.
rows.reference: Ganin jijjigar ƙasa da Indonesiya ta saba gani, ƙasar ta zama ta yi mummunan rashin shiryawa don bala’in rayuwa.

rows.output: Yayin da an gina wuraren tsarkake ruwa a Aceh, ba su da yawa a kan sauran bakin teku.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa an gina matsugunan Tsunami a cikin Aceh, ba su zama abin da ake iya gani a yankunan da ke kusa da bakin ruwa ba.

rows.output: Rashin bayyana siren na tsunami a Palu, ko da yake an yi gargadi, yana yiwuwa ya ba da gudummawa ga asarar rayuka.

rows.output: A mafi kyawun lokuta, tafiya tsakanin tsibiran Indonesia da yawa yana da wahala.

rows.output: Bala'o'in halitta suna sa aikin jigilar kaya ya zama mai rikitarwa.

rows.output: Jirgin asibiti da aka sanya a Lombok domin kula da wadanda suka jikkata a girgizar kasa yana kan hanyar zuwa Palu, amma zai dauki akalla kwanaki uku kafin ya isa wurin bala'in da ya faru.

rows.output: Shugaba Joko Widodo ya sa ya zama babban abu a yakin neman zabensa na inganta abin da ya faru a Indonesia, kuma ya kashe kudi sosai a kan hanyoyin mota da layin dogo.

rows.output: Amma, rashin kuɗin shiga ya yi wa gwamnatin Mista Joko wahala yayin da yake fuskantar sake zabensa a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin hankali na addini da ke ci gaba da kasancewa a Indonesia, inda membobin mafi yawan al'ummar Musulunci suka rungumi wani nau'in addini mai tsauri.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Mista Joko yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin-tashina bambanci addini da ya-ƙi-ci-ya-ƙi-cinyewa, inda mamobin Musulmai da suka fi rinjaye suka karɓi nau’in addini tsatstsaura.

rows.output: Fiye da mutane 1,000 ne suka mutu, kuma dubban mutane sun rasa matsugunansu yayin da kungiyar Kirista da Musulmi suka yi artabu a kan tituna, suna amfani da wukake, baka, da kibau, da sauran makamai masu sauki.

rows.output: Ya buga kwallo a hagu kafin ya yi bugunsa zuwa kusurwar da ke nesa.

rows.output: "Kawai yana ƙoƙarin shiga wannan matsayi, don samun ƙwallon da 'yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe suna wasa da shi gaba da yawa, don haka na yi ƙoƙari na ƙirƙira wa kai da yawa kamar yadda zai yiwu," Sturridge ya gaya wa LiverpoolFC.com.

rows.output: "Na ga Kante yana zuwa sai na ɗauki wani taɓawa na kuma ban yi tunanin hakan ba sosai na kuma kawai na ɗauki harbin."

rows.output: Chelsea ta jagoranci 1-0 a rabin lokaci bayan da aka ci kwallaye a minti na 25 daga Eden Hazard, dan wasan Belgium.

rows.output: Kovacic ya yi sauri ya ba da kwalla da kuma komawa.

rows.output: An ruwaito cewa mutane da yawa sun makale a cikin tarkacen gine-gine da suka fado a lokacin girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5 da ta afku a ranar Juma'a, wadda ta haifar da igiyoyin ruwa har zuwa ƙafa 20, in ji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a taron manema labarai.

rows.output: Birnin Palu, wanda ya fi mutane 380,000, ya cika da tarkace daga gine-ginen da suka ruguje.

rows.output: An gano wani mutum mai shekaru 44 a lokacin da ake yi masa tiyata a Grayson Mews a kan titin John, inda aka kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da ake zarginsa da kisan kai.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi kira ga mutane a yankin da suka ga ko su ji wani abu, su fito.

rows.output: Jami'in bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: 'Binciken yana cikin farkon matakin amma zan yi roƙon kowane wanda ya kasance a kusa da titin John a Birkenhead wanda ya ga ko ya ji wani abu mai ban mamaki ya tuntube mu.

rows.output: Hakanan zan roƙi duk wanda, musamman direbobin mota, wanda zai iya samun wani abu a cikin fayil ɗin dashcam, ya tuntubi mu domin suna iya samun bayanai masu mahimmanci ga bincike namu.

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka samu gawarwakin ta na cikin garin Birkenhead kuma an samu ta a cikin wani gida.

rows.output: A yau, abokan da ke ganin suna sanin mace ta zo wurin da suka yi tambayoyi game da inda aka samu ta a safe.

rows.output: Babban wakiltar Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft na Cromwell yana nuna ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihi na wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin har yanzu yana da daraja a yi bikin.

rows.output: Mista Goldsmith ya gaya wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin shi da yawa, watakila fiye a karshen karni na 19 fiye da yanzu, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin yanayin sa, ba shi da wata al'umma.

rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi hakan ne kawai a karkashin fahimtar cewa FBI za ta duba zarge-zargen da ake yi wa dan takarar na mako mai zuwa, wanda kuma 'yan Democrat na kananan kaburburan suka yi ta yunƙurin yin.

rows.output: Firaminista Theresa May ta yi wa masu sukar shirininta na barin Tarayyar Turai suna "wasan siyasa" da makomar Birtaniya da kuma lalata muradun kasa a cikin wani hira da jaridar Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Firaminista Theresa May ta soki masu suka na shirye-shiryenta na barin Tarayyar Turai da “maida abin siyasa” da makomar Birtaniyya da kuma zagon ƙasa ga abin da ƙasa ke sha’awa a cikin wata tattaunawa tare da jaridar Sunday Times.

rows.output: A cikin wani hira na gaba da wanda take yi a shafin farko na jaridar, tsohon ministan harkokin waje Boris Johnson ya kara kaimi kan hare-haren da take yi kan shirinta na Chequers na Brexit, yana cewa wata shawarar da ke cewa Birtaniya da EU za su tattara haraji na juna "abu ne mai ban mamaki."
rows.reference: A cikin wata tattaunawar a gaba da wadda aka yi da ita a kan shafin gaba na jaridar, tsohon ministanta kan harkokin ƙasashen waje Boris Johnson ya tirjewa a kan harinsa na shirin Chequers ɗin nata don Brexit, yana cewa wani ƙudurin da ke cewa ya kamata Birtaniyya da Tarayyar Turai su karɓi kuɗaɗen fito na juna ya kasance “gaba ɗaya shirme ne.”

rows.output: An kama wanda ake zargi Dyteon Simpson a cikin mutuwar Wayde Sims, dan wasan kwallon kafa na LSU
rows.reference: Harbin Wayde Sims ‘Yan sanda sun kama Dyteon Simpson da ake tuhuma a kan kisan ɗan wasan LSU.

rows.output: An kama wani wanda ake zargi da kashe Wayde Sims, dan kwallon kwando mai shekaru 20 a Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama wani da ake tuhuma a cikin mummunan harbi da ya kashe Wayde Sims, wani mai shekaru 20 kuma dan wasan ƙwallon kwando a LSU.

rows.output: Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20, an kama shi kuma an sanya shi a gidan yari bisa laifin kisan kai na biyu, a cewar Sashen 'yan sanda na Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: An kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20 kuma an kai shi kurkuku a kan wata tuhumar kisa mai mataki na biyu, inji Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sandan Baton Rouge.

rows.output: Jami'an sun fitar da bidiyo na tashin hankali tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashin sa a lokacin fadan.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun saki bidiyo na takardamar tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.

rows.output: An dawo da gilashin daga wurin da aka yi wa fashewar, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce sun sami DNA na Simpson a cikin su, a cewar CBS ta WAFB.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun sami gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin inda suka kuma ce sun sami abin halittar DNA na Simpson a kansu, kamar yadda rahoton WAFB mai alaƙa da CBS ya faɗa.

rows.output: Bayan yin tambayoyi ga Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da kashe Wayde.

rows.output: An sanya hannunsa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar The Advocate.

rows.output: Ofishin Coroner na East Baton Rouge Parish ya fitar da rahoton farko a ranar Juma'a, yana mai cewa dalilin mutuwar wani rauni ne daga bindigar da aka yi a kai zuwa wuyansa.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.output: Sashen ya ba da karramawa ga Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, dakin bincike na 'yan sanda na jihar, 'yan sandan Jami'ar Kudu, da 'yan ƙasar yankin da suka taimaka wajen bincike wanda ya kai ga kama.

rows.output: Jami'in wasanni na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa hukumar tsaro ta yankin bisa "jajircewarta da neman adalci."

rows.output: "Wannan shine abin da kuke damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," Wade ya ce.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kula da Hana Bala'i ta Kasa ta yi gargadi ga 'yan kasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su guje wa tsaunukan bayan da aka samu karuwar aiki a cikin kogon kuma ya yi rajistar fitar da iskar gas da ash 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da bugun da yawa da girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda ƙananan guntun ash ke rufe tagogin motocin a unguwanni daban-daban na birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana ilimin kasa da kasa sun lura da karuwar aiki a wani dutsen da ke da nisan mil 45 (72 km) kudu maso gabas da babban birnin kasar tun bayan da wani girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 ta afku a tsakiyar kasar Mexico a watan Satumba na shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: An yi aiki tun daga 1994.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar 'yanci na Catalan a gaban bikin shekaru 1 na kuri'ar 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suka yi taiki da 'yan sanda, a yayin da dubban mutane suka shiga zanga-zangar da ke nuna adawa da juna a ranar da ta yi da kuma shekarar da ta gabata a kan zaben raba kan Catalonia.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani rukuni na masu karewa da ke goyon bayan rabuwa da 'yan sanda na cikin tashin hankali sun jefar da su da kwai, sannan kuma sun jefa foda, suna haifar da duhu a kan tituna da za su yi cunkoso da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi artabu daga baya a rana tare da 'yan sanda suna amfani da sanduna don sarrafa tashin hankali.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da yawa, kungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yanci sun yi ihu da "Ba a mantawa, ba a gafartawa" a kan masu adawa da hadin kai suna ihu da "Rayuwar Sipaniya."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Mutanen goma sha hudu sun samu magani kan kananan raunuka da suka samu a lokacin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tunanin ya ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son 'yanci shekara guda bayan ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda aka ga ba bisa ka'ida ba daga Madrid amma an yi bikin da 'yan kasar Catalonia suka yi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: An zabi 'yan kuri'a da yawa don zama 'yan kasa da kansa, duk da cewa an samu karancin fitowar kuri'a, saboda wadanda suka yi adawa da rabuwa sun fi son kada su zama 'yan kasa da kansu.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: Bisa ga hukumomin Catalan, kusan mutane 1000 sun ji rauni a bara bayan da 'yan sanda suka yi ƙoƙarin hana zaben ci gaba a rumfunan zabe a fadin yankin a cikin tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar masu son 'yanci sun yi camping a daren Juma'a don hana wani baje kolin goyon bayan 'yan sanda na kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An gudanar da zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dauki wani sabon hanya.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani mai aikin lantarki da ke halartar zanga-zangar da ke neman 'yanci tare da matarsa ​​sun ce ba su da bege game da yiwuwar Catalonia ta samu 'yanci.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "Shekarar da ta gabata, mun yi rayuwa ta hanyar daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokuta.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalle iyaye na suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar kada kuri'a amma yanzu mun makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun yi nasara a zaben yankin a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun da ke goyon bayan 'yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya wajen ci gaba da samun karfi a wannan shekara, yayin da yawancin shahararrunsu ke cikin tsare ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a saboda rawar da suka taka wajen gudanar da zabe da kuma shelar 'yanci.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran motoci, wanda ya yi rikodin zanga-zangar da ke goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce an kara ta’azzara rikice-rikicen ne ta hannun ‘yan siyasa a bangarorin biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana kara damuwa," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin shugabannin Catalonia tara da ke tsare a lokacin shari'a tun karshen shekara ta da ta gabata, ya sanar da cewa zai tsunduma cikin zaben majalisar Turai a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa a matsayin dan takarar zabukan Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da raguwar dabi'un dimokuradiyya da kuma zaluncin da gwamnatin Spain ta yi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston tallafi, ya firgita Rangers, ya sanya Steven Gerrard ya samu rashin nasara na biyu a wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta zama babban bambanci yayin da Gary Holt's side ta yi daidai da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard tana ci gaba da rashin nasara a wajen gasar Premier a wannan kakar, kuma za ta kara da Hearts, wadanda ke kan matsayi na daya, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers na karbar Vienna a gasar Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a lokacin, sun faɗaɗa rashin nasara a gasar zuwa wasanni shida, yayin da kocin su Holt ya ci gaba da rashin nasara tun bayan ya maye gurbin Kenny Miller a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan baƙi masu sauƙi
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Tawagar Holt ya kamata ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin su ci, saboda hanyar da suka bi ta haifar da matsala ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi taushi amma ya ja kwallarsa a fuskar raga, sannan Alan Lithgow ya iya kaiwa gefensa kawai bayan ya yi tsalle ya hadu da kwallon da Craig Halkett ya yi a gefen raga.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masu masu suna da gamsuwa su bar Rangers su yi wasa a gaban su, suna sane da cewa za su iya damuwa da masu ziyara a lokacin da za a yi.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muhimmiyar kwallo.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: An ba wa Rangers bugun fanareti, kuma Livingston ya yi amfani da shi, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don saita Menga, wanda ya dauki kwallon ya ci daga tsakiyar akwatin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan mataki, Rangers sun mamaye mallakar kwallo amma sun sami tsarin tsaron gida ba a iya shawo kansa ba kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ya kasance ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, duk da haka Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: "Kuri'a don tabbatar da Alkalin Kavanaugh ita ce kuri'a don tabbatar da daya daga cikin manyan tunanin shari'a na zamanmu, alkalin da ke da tarihin hidima na jama'a mai kyau," ya gaya wa taron masu goyon bayan West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya yi nuni da nufin nadin Kavanaugh, yayin da yake magana kan muhimmanci da jam'iyyar Republican ta yi a zaben tsakiya.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.output: "Kwana biyar daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓukan da suka fi muhimmancin rayuwa.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina gudana sosai," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.output: "Abin da ya sa nake ko'ina cikin yaki don manyan 'yan takarar."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan Democrat suna da niyyar "juriya da toshewa."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.output: An yi hasashen cewa za a yi zabe na farko na tsarin da za a yi a kan bene na majalisar dattijai kan nada Kavanaugh ba da jimawa ba fiye da Juma'a, wani jami'in shugaban jam'iyyar GOP ya gaya wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.output: An kashe mutane da yawa a cikin girgizar kasa ta Indonesia, tsunami, tare da yawan mace-mace yana iya karuwa.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.output: A kalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa sun nutse cikin teku yayin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka yi ta shiga bakin teku, lokacin da wani babban girgizar kasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomin a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi ta taru a bakin teku a cikin birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da igiyoyin da suka kai mita shida (ƙafa 18) suka yi karo da bakin teku a lokacin faduwar rana, inda suka kama mutane da yawa a cikin ruwan da ke gudana, suna lalata duk abin da ke cikin hanyar su.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An binne tsunami bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazan tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wadanda suka ji rauni," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kare muhalli ta Indiya BNPB a wani taron manema labarai a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "An yi tsunami ba tare da wata hanya ba, ya ja motoci, itatuwa, gidajen, ya buga komai a kasa," in ji Nugroho, yana kara cewa, tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai bude ido a kan gudun kilometa 800 a cikin sa'a (497 mph) kafin ya buga bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun haura bishiyoyi don tserewa daga tsunami kuma sun tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kusan mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyin 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jiragen sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata da yawa daga cikin gine-gine da shaguna, an jujjuya gada kuma an ruguje, an kuma kewaye da wani masallaci da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: An ci gaba da girgizar kasa a cikin birnin gabar teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Indonesiya ta ce a cikin wata sanarwar cewa, makamin da aka jefa a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan 200 na karfin bam din atomic da aka jefar a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: An bayyana yanayin birnin, wanda yake a ƙarshen wani bakin da ya yi nisa da kuma sirara, ya kara girma da girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana barnar da ta yi “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubban gidajen, asibiti, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An sami gawar wasu wadanda suka mutu a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an samu asara da kuma lalacewa a bakin teku mai nisan kilomita 300 (190 mil) a arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ke kusa da cibiyar girgbin.

rows.output: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa da kungiyar Red Cross ta yi, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa na tafiya zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafi.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan yana da ban mamaki, amma zai iya zama mafi muni."

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokaci da aka fitar da gargadin.

rows.output: Ina ganin "kuna" ita ce mafi yawan kalmomin da ake amfani da su a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki, kuma a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki yana nufin "kai," in ji West a farkon wannan shekara, yana magana da mai gabatar da shirye-shiryen rediyo Big Boy.
rows.reference: “Na yi imani ‘ye’ kalma ce da aka fi amfani sosai a cikin Baibul, kuma a cikin Baibul tana nufin ‘kai,” inji West a farkon wannan shekarar, yana tattauna sunan faifan ɗinsa tare da mai karɓan baƙi na rediyo Big Boy.

rows.output: Yana ɗaya daga cikin fitattun mawakan rap da suka canza sunan su.
rows.reference: Yana daga cikin sanannun rappers da suka canza sunansu.

rows.output: Sean Combs an san shi da Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma a wannan shekarar ya bayyana sonansa na suna Love da Brother Love.
rows.reference: An san Sean Combs da sunaye iri-iri a matsayin Puff Daddy, P. Diddy ko Diddy, amma wannan shekarar ya sanar cewa fifikonsa na sunayen Love da Brother Love ne.

rows.output: Wani tsohon abokin yammaci, JAY-Z, kuma ya yi amfani da shi ko ba tare da haɗin kai da manyan haruffa ba.
rows.reference: Wani abokin haɗin gwiwa na West, JAY-Z, shi ma ya sha yi da ko ba tare da wani layi gajere na tsakiyar kalma da manyan baƙaƙe.

rows.output: Mexico's AMLO ya yi alkawari ba za a yi amfani da sojojin da ke kan fararen hula ba.
rows.reference: AMLO na Mexico ya yi alkawarin ba zai yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Mexico mai jiran gado Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari da ba za ya yi amfani da karfin soja a kan fararen hula ba yayin da kasar ke gab da cika shekaru 50 da wani mummunan ramuwar gayya da dalibai suka yi.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza cewa "ba za a taba amfani da sojoji wajen murkushe mutanen Mexico ba."
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: An harbe 'yan sanda a wani zanga-zangar zaman lafiya a filin a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe mutane sama da 300 a lokacin da motsin matasa na hagu ke fara girma a duk fadin Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari da taimakawa matasa 'yan Mexiko ta hanyar bayar da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda ke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'in jama'a kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi yana jawo matasa zuwa kungiyoyin laifuka.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudin A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da kasar Sin ke kara yawan aikin hankali na wucin gadi, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudin da take kashewa a fannin bincike, in ji mai zuba jari da kuma mai aiki da AI, Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: An yi sharhi ne bayan da sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka suka yi sanarwar AI, duk da cewa Amurka gaba ɗaya ba ta da wani tsarin AI na hukuma.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A lokacin, kasar Sin ta gabatar da shirin ta na shekara ta baya: tana da niyyar zama No.1 a fannin kirkire-kirkire na AI kafin 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Kudin bincike na AI ya ninka zai zama kyakkyawan fara, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk sauran kasashe suna da nisa a bayansa, kuma muna neman sabbin abubuwan da suka faru a AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Kudade na iya ninka, hakan na iya ninka damar cewa babban nasarar da ta zo a AI za ta kasance a Amurka, Lee ta gaya wa CNBC a wata hira da ta yi a wannan makonni.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: Lee, wanda littafin sa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" ya fito a watan da ya gabata a Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shi ne shugaban Kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanoni na AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya kasance jami'in bincike na Microsoft kuma shugaban reshen Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasar fasaha ta gwamnati ta Amurka a baya kamar gasar Robotics Challenge ta Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency kuma ta tambayi lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, don taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana a Amurka sau da yawa suna yin aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ne ke ɗaukar manyan malamai ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanoni na fasaha sun dauki manyan mutane daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canje a cikin manufofin shiga ƙasa na iya taimaka wa Amurka wajen ƙara karfin ta a fannin AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katunan kore su yi wa PhDs a fannin AI, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar Jihohin kasar Sin ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar hankali ta zamani a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyya ta Kasa ta kasar Sin tana ba da tallafin kudi ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi kamar yadda Asusun Kimiyya na Kasa da sauran kungiyoyin gwamnati ke ba masu binciken Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya fi ƙarancin a China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekara, Ma'aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali na Wucin Gadi, wadda aka yi niyya don haɗa abokan hulɗa daga masana'antu da ilimi, kuma Fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Majalisar Zabe kan Hankali na Wucin Gadi.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shirin da ake kira AI Na Gaba.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana zuba sama da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a cikin bincike na AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A lokacin, ba a ga wani aikin dokokin Amurka da ke neman kafa wata hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan hankali ba a cikin watanni.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Macedonians suna kada kuri'a a zaben kan ko za su canza sunan kasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: An yi wa mutanen Makedoniya zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Arewa Makedoniya," wanda zai warware rigingimun da suka dore da kasar Girka, wanda ya hana ta shiga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Makedoniya, tana mai cewa sunan makwabta na arewa yana wakiltar da'awar ƙasa, kuma ta hana shiga NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatin biyu sun yi yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da ra'ayin kasa sun ce canjin zai rage asalin al'ummar Slavia na Macedoniya.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zabe ba a zaben da za a yi, kuma yakin neman zabe ya haifar da shakku kan ko za a samu kaso 50 cikin 100 na masu jefa kuri'a da ake bukata don a yi zabe mai inganci.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Shin kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka?
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canjin sunan, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce hakan farashi ne mai kyau don neman shiga cikin kungiyoyin kamar EU da NATO ga Makedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo a yau ne domin ina kada kuri'a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Makedoniya domin su iya rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai kyau ga kowa." in ji Olivera Georgijevska, 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba aatar da shi a shari'a ba, amma 'yan majalisar dokoki da yawa sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon kuri'ar, don haka ta zama mai matukar muhimmancin.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sunan canjin zai buƙatar rinjaye biyu bisa uku a majalisar dokokin kasar.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zabe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoton rashin daidaiton zabe ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu jefa kuri'a ta kasance kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zaben majalisar dokokin kasar a shekarar 2016 lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu rajista suka kada kuri'a.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda yara na, wurinmu a Turai ne," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro ka aha ha gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ bụ n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọasị ya.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ama jijiji na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara ara ara, pwp pụtarakwa ihe mkpofu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị ahụkebe" ma tụnye aro ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Otu onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya bụ "mepere emepe" gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere okwu okwu site na MWP gaa Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'ọnọdụ a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka okwu Yorkshire Bekee nke mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-arụ ọrụ n'iwu iwu iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ na aha ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Ụlọ Nzukọ na-akpọ ga-adaberekwa n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Ọchịchị nke Wales 2017 nyere ndị ọchịchị Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Kansụl bipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọn ahụ tọrọ ntọala maka ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha ukwuu n'oge nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.
