rows.reference: Ka ala ọmajijiji Lombok mechara, dịka ọmụmaatụ, agwara ndị nzụkọ mba ofesi na abụghị nke gọọmentị na achọghị ha.

rows.output: Ọbụna n'agbanyeghị na ihe karịrị pasentị iri nke ndị bi n'agbata Lombok ka ebugara n'ebe ọzọ, a na-ekwupụtabeghị ihe mberede mba, ihe a chọrọ iji kpalie enyemaka mba ụwa.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi na achụpụla karịa pasentị 10 nke ọnụọgụgụ nke Lombok n’ụlọ ha, akpọpụtaghị ọdachi mba ọ bụla, ihe izizi maka ịchọ enyemaka ndị mba ofesi.

rows.output: "N'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, ihe na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma, ha egosila n'ụzọ doro anya na ha anaghị arịọ maka enyemaka mba ụwa, ya mere ọ na-esiri ike." Maazị Sumbung kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’imirikiti okwu, na mwute, ha kwuputere ya ka o doo anya na ha achọghị enyemaka mba ofesi, yabụ ọ bụ ihe aka mgba, “Nw. Sumbung kwuru.

rows.output: N'oge a na-eme ka ndị na-echekwa ụmụaka na-eme otu ndị ga-aga Palu, ọ ka na-ejighị n'aka ma ndị ọrụ mba ofesi nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n'ala.
rows.reference: Ebe Save the Children na edekọba otu iji gaa Palu, o doghi ya anya ma ndị ọrụ mba ofesi enwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n’ala ahụ.

rows.output: Maazị Sutopo, onye na-ekwu okwu na-ahụ maka ihe mberede mba, kwuru na ndị ọrụ Indonesia na-enyocha ọnọdụ dị na Palu iji chọpụta ma ndị ọrụ mba ofesi ga-ekwe ka ha tinye aka na mbọ enyemaka.
rows.reference: Maazị Sutopo, onye okwu okwu ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi mba, kwuru ndị ọrụ Indonesia na enyocha ọnọdụ dị na Palu iji hụ ma a ga-ahapụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ mba ofesi ịnyere aka na mbọ enyemaka ahụ.

rows.output: N'ịtụle ịkwapụ ala nke Indonesia na-enwe mgbe niile, obodo ahụ ka na-adịghị njikere nke ọma maka ihe ijuanya nke okike.
rows.reference: Ejide n’aka ala ọmajijiji nke Indonesia na enwe oge niile, obodo ahụ adịghị nkwadobe ma ncha maka iwe nke ekereụwa.

rows.output: N'oge ahụ, a na-ewu ụlọ mgbaba tsunami n'Aceh, ma ha abụghị ihe a na-ahụkarị n'akụkụ osimiri ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ka arụrụ ụlọ nche tsunami na Aceh, ọ bụghị ihe a na ahụ ebe niile n’akụkụ mmiri ndị ọzọ.

rows.output: Nchegbu nke enweghị siren ịdọ aka ná ntị nke tsunami na Palu, n'agbanyeghị na ọ dị, nwere ike ịbata n'ịnwụ n'oge.
rows.reference: Ihe mgbama nke tsunami na adịghị na Palu, ọbụlagodi na etiri amụma nke ịdọ aka na ntị, nwere ike iso bute ọnwụ ndị mmadụ.

rows.output: N'oge kacha mma, ịga njem n'etiti ọtụtụ agwaetiti Indonesia na-esiri ike.
rows.reference: N’oge kachasị mma, ịga njem n’etiti imirikiti agwaetiti nke Indonesia bụ ihe mgba.

rows.output: Mkpagbu ndị sitere n'okike na-eme ka ihe ndị dị mkpa sie ike.
rows.reference: Ọdachi mba na eme ka nhazi gbagwojukwuo anya.

rows.output: ụgbọ ọgwụ nke e debere na Lombok iji gwọọ ndị metụtara ala ọma, na-aga Palu, ma ọ ga-ewe opekata mpe ụbọchị atọ ka ọ ruo ebe ihe ọjọọjị ọhụrụ a mere.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ mmiri ụlọ ọgwụ edowere na Lombok iji lekọta ndị ala ọmajijiji metụtara na aga ugbu a na Palu, mana ọ ga-ewe opekata mpe ụbọchị atọ iji ruo ọnọdụ nke ọdachi ọhụrụ ahụ.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo mere ka imeziwanye ihe owuwu Indonesia dara ada bụ isi ihe dị n'ime atụmatụ ntụliaka ya, o wee na-etinye ego nke ukwuu n'okporo ụzọ na okporo ụzọ ụgbọ oloko.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo mere imelite akụrụngwa nke Indonesia mebisiri emebi isiokwu nke mgbasa ozi nhọpụta ya, mana o tufusiela ego n’okporo ụzọ na ụzọ ụgbọ oloko.

rows.output: Ma ọ bụghị na ego na-adịghị mma emezuola ọchịchị Maazị Joko ka ọ na-eche ntụliaka ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa.
rows.reference: Mana enweghị ego na egbu ọchịchị nke Maazị Joko ka ọ na eche nhọpụtagharị n’afọ na esote.

rows.output: Maazị Joko na-eche nrụgide ihu site n'ichekwa esemokwu na-aga n'ihu n'etiti ndị otu na Indonesia, ebe ndị otu ndị Alakụba na-achị na-anabata ụdị okpukpe ndị na-ekwusa ozi ọma.
rows.reference: Maazị Joko na echekwa nrụgide n’aka esemokwu ngalaba dị kemgbe na Indonesia, ebe ndị otu nke ọnụọgụgụ Muslim ka ukwuu nabatara ụdị nchekwa nke okwukwe.

rows.output: Karịrị mmadụ 1,000 nwụrụ, ma ndị mmadụ dị iche iche tọgbọrọ n'ụlọ ha ka ndị otu Ndị Kraịst na ndị Alakụba na-alụ ọgụ n'okporo ámá, na-eji mma, ọnyà, na ihe ndị ọzọ na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Egburu karịa ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ 1,000 ma chụpụ iri puku kwụrụ iri puku ndị mmadụ n’ụlọ ha dị ka ndị omempụ Ndị Otu Kraịst na Alakụba na alụ ọgụ n’okporo ụzọ, na eji mma, ụta na ube, yana ngwa-ọgụ ndị ọzọ jọrọ njọ.

rows.output: Nleba anya: Liverpool's Daniel Sturridge dips deep equalizer vs. Chelsea
rows.reference: Lelee: Nsaghachi Daniel Sturridge nke Liverpool n’ime ngwụcha oge vs Chelsea

rows.output: Daniel Sturridge zọpụtalarị Liverpool n'agha Premier League megide Chelsea na 89th nkeji na Satọde na Stamford Bridge na London.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge zọrọ Liverpool n’aka nfụlahụ Premier League n’aka Chelsea site na ịnye goolu na nkeji nke 89 na Satode nke mere na Stamford Bridge dị na London.

rows.output: N'oge na-adịghị anya, Shaqiri nyere Sturridge ka ọ gbaa bọọlụ n'ime ebe dị mita iri atọ n'ebe Chelsea nọ.
rows.reference: Sturridge nwetara pass n’aka Xherdan Shaqiri ka ọ nọ ebe yaadị 30 na mpụga nke goolu Chelsea ka ndị otu ya na achụ 1-0.

rows.output: O mere ka ọkpọ ahụ gaa n'aka ekpe ya tupu ọ banye n'ụzọ dị anya.
rows.reference: O tinyere bọọlụ ahụ n’akaekpe ya tupu ọ gbaa shọt n’isi elu postu ahụ.

rows.output: Mgbalị ahụ gbara n'elu igbe ahụ ka ọ na-ese n'elu aka nri elu nke net.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa ahụ gara n’elu bọksị ahụ ka ọ na eselụ aga n’akụkụ elu akanri nke net ahụ.

rows.output: Bọọl ahụ dara n'ikpeazụ n'elu Kepa Arrizabalaga na-awụlikwa elu ma daa n'ime net.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ ahụ mechara gafee Kepa Arrizabalaga na agbatị aka wee dakpuo n’ime net ahụ.

rows.output: "Ọ dị nnọọ na-agbalị ịbata n'ọnọdụ ahụ, ịbata n'ụgbọ na ndị egwuregwu dị ka Shaq na-egwu ya n'ihu dị ka o kwere mee, ya mere, m na-agbalị ịmepụta oge maka onwe m dị ka o kwere mee." Sturridge gwara LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ ịnwa ịbanye n’ọnọdụ ahụ, ijide bọọlụ ma ndi egwu dị ka Shaq na agba ya aga ihu oge niile ole enwenwuru ike, yabụ m onwe m nwara iwepụta onwe m ole m nwenwuru ike, “Sturridge gwara LiverpoolFC.com.

rows.output: "Ahụrụ m Kante ka ọ na-abịa ma were otu mmetụta ma ghara ịtụle ya nke ukwuu ma were naanị shot ahụ."
rows.reference: “Ahụrụ m Kante ka ọ na abịa, metụ ya otu ugboro, echeghị m maka ya ọtụtụ, gbaa ya ozugbo.”

rows.output: Chelsea nwere 1-0 n'isi oge, mgbe ha nwetara goolu n'ime nkeji iri abụọ na ise site n'Eden Hazard, onye ama ama na Belgium.
rows.reference: Chelsea nọ n’ihu 1-0 ka agara ezumike ka enyechara goolu na nkeji 25 site n’aka Eden Hazard nwa Belgium ama ama.

rows.output: Onye na-agba bọọlụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ na-ehichapụ ka ọ na-eweghachi Mateo Kovacic n'ụzọ ahụ, tupu ọ gbanarị n'akụkụ etiti ahụ wee gbaba n'ime ọkara Liverpool.
rows.reference: Onye ihu nke Blues ahụ nyere Mateo Kovacic pass azụ ụkwụ n’egwuregwu ahụ, tupu ọ gbapụ ọsọ n’akụkụ ọkara ama egwuregwu wee gbabanye n’ọkara nke Liverpool.

rows.output: Kovacic mere ka ọ na-agba ọsọ ma wepụ ya n'etiti.
rows.reference: Kovacic mere wete mara ibe dị ọsọ n’ọkara ama egwuregwu.

rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, ọ gbara bọọlụ mara mma, na-eduga Hazard n'ime igbe.
rows.reference: Ọ gbara ọmarịcha bọọlụ, nke dubara Hazard n’ime bọksị ahụ.

rows.output: Hazard gbara ọsọ ọsọ n'ihu nchebe ahụ ma tinye ya n'ime neti dị anya na Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard gbafere dịfensị ahụ wee tinye goolu ahụ n’isi net site na iji shọt eji ụkwụ akaekpe gbaa wee gafere Alisson Becker nke Liverpool.

rows.output: Liverpool na-agba Napoli n'ọkwa otu n'asọmpi Champions League na elekere atọ nke ụbọchị Wenezde na Stadio San Paolo na Naples, Ịtali.
rows.reference: Liverpool na Napoli ga-aga ọgụ n’ọkwa izizi nke Champions League na elekere 3 nke ehihie na Wenesde na Stadio San Paolo dị na Naples, Italy.

rows.output: Mmụba ndị nwụrụ n'ihi tsunami dị na Indonesia eruola 832
rows.reference: Ndị nwụrụ anwụ na tsunami Indonesia eruola 832

rows.output: Mmụba ndị nwụrụ n'ime ala ọma jijiji na tsunami nke Indonesia eruola 832, ụlọ ọrụ ihe mberede nke obodo ahụ kwuru n'ụtụtụ Sọnde.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ na ala ọmajijiji na tsunami nke Indonesia eruola 832, ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi nke obodo ahụ kwuru na isi ụtụtụ nke Sonde.

rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ka a na-akọ na haere n'ime ihe ndị dara n'ihi 7.5 magnitude nke ala ọma jijiji nke mere Fraịde ma kpalie ebili mmiri dị elu nke 20 ụkwụ, onye na-ekwu okwu n'ụlọ ọrụ ahụ bụ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho gwara ọgbakọ ndị nta akụkọ.
rows.reference: Ekpesara na ejidere imirikiti ndị mmadụ n’okpuru ụlọ ndị dara ada nke ala ọmajijiji 7.5 butere nke mere na Friday wee kpalite nnukwu ikuku ruru ụkwụ 20, onye okwu okwu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho gwara nzụkọ ndị nchụ nta akụkọ.

rows.output: Obodo Palu, nke nwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 380,000, juru n'ire ere n'ihi na ụlọ ndị dara.
rows.reference: Obodo nke Palu, nke nwere karịa ndị mmadụ 380,000, kpojuru n’ibe ahịhịa si na ụlọ ndị dara ada.

rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii jidere nwoke dị afọ 32 n'ụzọ a na-enyo enyo maka igbu ọchụ mgbe a gburu nwanyị.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii jidere otu nwoke, 32, na nnyocha nke igbu mmadụ ka eji mma magbuo otu nwanyị

rows.output: Mwube nyocha e mere mgbe a chọtara ahụ nwanyị ahụ n’Birkenhead, Merseyside n’ụtụtụ a.
rows.reference: Ebidola nnyocha igbu mmadụ ka ahụchara ahụ otu nwanyị na Birkenhard, Merseyside n’ụtụtụ a.

rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ 44 a chọtara n'isi ụbọchị nke 7.55 n'ụzọ Grayson Mews n'okporo ụzọ John, na otu nwoke dị afọ 32 ka a na-enyo enyo na a na-enyo enyo maka igbu ọchụ.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ mmadụ afọ 44 ahụ na 7:55 ụtụtụ nwere ọnya mma na Grayson Mews na Okporo Ụzọ John, ejidere otu nwoke dị afọ 32 na nnyocha nke igbu mmadụ.

rows.output: Ndị uwe ojii agbalịla ka ndị mmadụ nọ n'ógbè ahụ bịaruo n'ihu ma ọ bụrụ na ha hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii na arịọ ndị mmadụ nọ na mpaghara ahụ onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla ka ọ bịa ihu.

rows.output: Onye nchọpụta Inspector Brian O'Hagan kwuru: "Nnyocha ahụ dị na mbido ma m ga-arịọ onye ọ bụla nọ n'akụkụ John Street na Birkenhead bụ onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla na-enyo enyo ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị.
rows.reference: Onye Uwe Ojii Ịnspektọ Brian O'Hagan kwuru: ‘Nnyocha ahụ nọ na mbido ya mana m ga-arịọ mmadụ ọ bụla nọ n’ogige nke Okporo Ụzọ John dị na Birkenhead onye hụrụ ma ọ bụ nụ ihe ọ bụla a na enyo enyo ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị.

rows.output: M ga-agwa onye ọ bụla, karịsịa ndị na-anya ụgbọ ala, ndị nwere ike ịdekọ ihe ọ bụla na igwe dashcam ka ha kpọtụrụ anya anyị n'ihi na ha nwere ike inwe ozi dị mkpa na nyocha anyị.
rows.reference: M ga-achọ ịrịọ mmadụ ọ bụla, karịchara ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ taksị, onye nwere ike ijide ihe ọ bụla na nseta dashkam ka ọ kpọtụrụ anyị n’ihi ha nwere ike ịnwe ozi dị mkpa maka nnyocha anyị.’

rows.output: Onye na-ekwu okwu ndị uwe ojii ekwenyela na nwanyị ahụ nke a chọtara nwụrụ anwụ bụ onye obodo Birkenhead ma a chọtara ya n'ime ụlọ.
rows.reference: Onye okwu okwu ndị uwe ojii ekwenyela na nwanyị ahụ ahụrụ ahụ bụ onye mpaghara na Birkenhead, ahụrụ ya n’ime otu akụ.

rows.output: N'ehihie a, ndị enyi ndị kwenyere na ha maara nwanyị ahụ rutela ebe a na-eme ihe iji jụọ ajụjụ gbasara ebe a chọtara ya n'ụtụtụ a.
rows.reference: N’ehihie a ndị enyi kwere na ha ma nwanyị ahụ abịala n’ogige ahụ iji jụọ ajụjụ maka ebe ahụrụ ya n’ụtụtụ a.

rows.output: Nnyocha na-aga n'ihu ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ha na-eme usoro ịgwa ndị ikwu nke onye ahụ metụtara.
rows.reference: A na eme nnyocha ugbu a dị ka ndị uwe ojii si kwuo ha na akwadobe ịgwa osote nke onye ihe ahụ mere.

rows.output: Onye na-anya ụgbọ ala na-ebi na Grayson Mews enwetala na ọ na-agbalị ịlaghachi n'ụlọ ya, mana ndị uwe ojii na-agwa ya na onye ọ bụla enweghị ike ịbata ma ọ bụ pụọ n'ụlọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ taksị bi na Grayson Mew nwara ịbanyechi na be ya mana ndị uwe ojii gwara ya na ọ nweghị onye na abanye ma ọ bụ apụ n’ụlọ ahụ.

rows.output: Ọ dị ya ka ọ na-ekwu okwu mgbe ọ chọpụtara ihe mere.
rows.reference: Okwu ekweghị ya mgbe ọ chọpụtara ihe mere.

rows.output: Ndị bi na ya ugbu a na-agwa ha na ọ ga-ewerekwu awa tupu ha enwee ike ịlaghachi n'ime.
rows.reference: A na agwa ndị bi ebe ahụ ugbu a, na ọ ga-ewe ogologo oge tupu ahapụ ha ịbanyechi ọzọ.

rows.output: Onye uwe ojii kwuru na otu nwoke na ndị uwe ojii na-ahụ ugbu a ebe ahụ dum dị ka ebe mpụ.
rows.reference: Anụrụ ka otu onye uwe ojii na agwa otu nwoke na a na ahụta mpaghara ahụ niile ka ogige omekome.

rows.output: Ọ na-emegharị 'ọ dị egwu'.

rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh enweela "ụtọ nke ịkpọasị, ihe ijuwe" nke pati Democratic n'oge usoro nhọpụta ya.
rows.reference: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh “ataala ahụhụ obi akpọ, iwe” nke ndị Otu Demokrat n’usoro nhọpụta ya.

rows.output: Kavanaugh gara n'ihu n'ihu Congress na Tọzdee, na-ewuli elu na n'ụzọ mmetụta uche na-agọnahụ ebubo sitere n'aka Christine Blasey Ford na o mere ihe na-akparị ya ihe n'afọ ndị 1990 mgbe ha bụ ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh gbara akaebe n’ihu Nzụkọ na Tọsde, jiri iwe na obi mmụọ wee gọnarị ebubo nke Christine Blasey Ford na ọ wakporo ya n’afọ iri gara aga mgbe ha bụ ndị ntorobia.

rows.output: Ford nwekwara na-ekwu okwu n'oge a na-ekwu maka ebubo ya.
rows.reference: Ford gbakwara akaebe nke ọnụnụ ahụ gbasara ebubo ya.

rows.output: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na "ndị America hụrụ ihe okike na nke dị mma na obi ike" nke Kavanaugh n'ụbọchị ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na “Ndị America hụrụ amamịghe na agwa na mgbamume” nke Kavanaugh n’ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.output: "Vootu iji kwado Ụkụ Kavanaugh bụ votu iji kwado otu n'ime uche iwu kacha mara amara n'oge anyị, onye ọka ikpe nwere ndekọ ọla edo nke ọrụ ọha."
rows.reference: “Otu ntuli aka iji kwenye na Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ otu ntuli aka iji kwenye n’otu uche iwu kachasị tozuo etozu n’oge anyị, onye ọkaiwu nwere ndekọ nke ọrụ ọhaneze na amuke amuke,” ọ gwara igwe mmadụ nke ndị nkwado West Virginia.

rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụ kwuru n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi maka nhọpụta Kavanaugh mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka mkpa ndị Republican na-eme ntụliaka n'oge ntuli aka etiti.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala ahụ iji ụzọ ọzọ wee rụtụ aka na nhọpụta Kavanaugh ka ọ na ekwu maka mkpa nke mpụta ndị Repọblikan na ntuli aka ndị etiti afọ.

rows.output: "Isi izu ise site na otu n'ime ntuli aka kachasị mkpa n'oge anyị.
rows.reference: “Izu ise fọdụrụ tupu otu ntuli aka kachasị mkpa na ndụ anyị.

rows.output: Anaghị m agba ọsọ, ma m na-agba ọsọ nke ọma," o kwuru.
rows.reference: Anaghị m apụta, mana m na apụta n’ezie,” o kwuru.

rows.output: "Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji na-agba ọsọ n'ebe niile na-alụ ọgụ maka ndị na-eme ihe dị mma."
rows.reference: “Ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na akwado ndị anamachọihe mara oke mma.”

rows.output: Trump kwuru na ndị Democrats na-aga n'ihu "ịjịnị na iguzogide."
rows.reference: Trump rụrụ aka na ndị Demokrats nọ na njem iji “kwụsị ma gbochido.”

rows.output: Ntụle mbụ nke usoro nke Senate ala na Kavanaugh's nhọpụta a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme n'oge na-adịghị anya karịa Fraịde, onye isi GOP ndị isi enyela CNN ozi.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka izizi dị mkpa n’ọkwa Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka nhọpụta nke Kavanaugh ka atụrụ anya ga-eme tupu Fraịde gachaa, onye otu ọchịchị GOP dị elu gwara CNN.

rows.output: Puku ndị e gburu n'ihi ịkụda ala Indonesia, tsunami, na ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebili.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji, tsunami, nke Indonesia gburu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ, ọgụgụ ka na agbago

rows.output: N'ime ndị nwụrụ anwụ, ọtụtụ ndị ebugara n'ụsọ osimiri ka nnukwu ebili mmiri na-akụ n'ụsọ osimiri mgbe nnukwu ala ọma na tsunami dakwasịrị n'agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị kwuru na Satọde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe egburu ndị mmadụ 384, ka nnukwu ikuku dara n’akụkụ osimiri ekpochapụrụ ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, mgbe nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami kụrụ agwaetiti Indonesia nke Sulawesi, ndị ikikere kwuru na Satọde.

rows.output: N'ime ndị mmadụ iri ngo nọ n'ebe ahụ maka emume n'akụkụ osimiri obodo Palu n'ụbọchị Fraịde mgbe ebili mmiri dị elu nke mita isii (ụkwụ iri na asatọ) kụrụ n'akụkụ osimiri n'oge mgbụsị akwụkwọ, na-eburu ọtụtụ mmadụ n'ụzọ ha na-ehichapụ ihe ọ bụla n'ụzọ ha.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ bịakọtara maka emume n’akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu na Fraịde mgbe ikuku ruru ogo mita isii (ụkwụ 18) dara n’ala n’oge uhuruchi, zara imirikiti banye n’ọnwụ ha ma na emebi ihe ọ bụla dị n’ụzọ ya.

rows.output: Mgbaba mmiri ahụ sochiri 7.5 n'ogologo ala 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunami ahụ sotere ala ọmajiji ike 7.5.

rows.output: "N'oge ihe egwu tsunami mere ụbọchị gara aga, ndị mmadụ ka na-eme ihe n'ụsọ osimiri ma ha emeghị ngwa ngwa ịgbapụ ma ha ghọrọ ndị a tọhapụrụ." Sutopo Purwo Nugroho bụ onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka ịgwọ nsogbu BNPB kwuru n'oge a na-akọ akụkọ na Jakarta.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ihe egwu tsunami ahụ bidoro ụnyahụ, ndị mmadụ nọ na eme mmemme ha n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, ha agbaghị ọsọ ozugbo, ya mere o ji metụta ha,” Sutopo Purwo Nugrogo, okwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ njikwa ọdachi mba nke Indonesia BNPS kwuru na nchịkọta na Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ọkụ mmiri ahụ abụghị naanị ya, ọ na-ebu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ na-akụ ihe niile n'ala," Nugroho kwuru, na-ekwu na ọkụ mmiri ahụ agafeela n'oké osimiri na ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu ọ daa n'ikpere mmiri.
rows.reference: “Tsunami ahụ abịaghị n’aka ya, o burulu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile nọ n’ala,” Nugroho kwuru, na ekwukwa na tsunami ahụ gafere na nnukwu osimiri n’ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu o daruo n’akụkụ osimiri.

rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịgoro n’osisi ka ha si n’ogbugba ahụ pụọ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịrị elu osisi iji gbanarị tsunami ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.

rows.output: N'ime mmadụ 16,700, a chụpụrụ ha n'ebe 24 dị na Palu.
rows.reference: Ebugara ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 16,700 n’ama 24 dị na Palu.

rows.output: Foto ikuku e wepụtara site na ụlọ ọrụ ihe mberede gosiri na ọtụtụ ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mebiri, àkwà mmiri gbawara agbawa na daa, na ụlọ alakụba gbara mmiri gburugburu.
rows.reference: Ọsịse elu nke ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi ahụ buputere gosiri imirikiti ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa emebisiri, akwa mmiri gbagochara ma daa yana ụlọ alakụba mmiri gbara okirikiri.

rows.output: Mgbanaka gara n'ihu na-akụda obodo dị n'akụkụ osimiri n'ụbọchị Satọde.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji gara n’ihu na eme n’ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ na Satọde.

rows.output: Mmeghachi omume nke ala iberibe ahụ dị na mpaghara nwere mmadụ nde 2.4.
rows.reference: Enwere mmetụta usoro nke ala ọmajiji na mpaghara nwere ndị mmadụ nde 2.4.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka nyocha na itinye teknụzụ (BPPT) kwuru nkwupụta na ike a na-ebupụta site na nnukwu ala ọma jijiji nke Fraịde bụ ihe dị ka 200 ugboro ike nke bọmbụ atomik a tụbara na Hiroshima n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ maka Nyocha na Ntinye nke Teknụzụ nke Indonesia (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupute na ike nnukwu ọmajiji nke Fraịde buputere dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 nke ike nke ogbunigwe atọmik atụsara na Hiroshima na Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.

rows.output: Obodo ahụ dị n'akụkụ ọnụ n'ụsọ osimiri dị ogologo, nke nwere ike ime ka oke nke tsunami dịkwuo elu, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ala nke obodo ahụ, nke tukwu na ngwụcha nke mpaghara osimiri toro ogologo, dị warawara, nwere ike ibuwanye nha nke tsunami ahụ, ka o kwuru.

rows.output: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ dị ka "nke ukwuu" ma kwuo na puku ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ụlọ ahịa, na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ agbawala.
rows.reference: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ ka “ihe gbasara agbasa” ma kwuo puku kwụrụ puku nke ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ọdụ ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ nkwari dara.

rows.output: Mkpụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị ahụ e gburu egbu ka achọtara n'okpuru ihe ndị dara ada, o kwuru, na-ekwu na mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ na 29 na-efunarị.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara n’okpuru ahịhịa nke ụlọ ndị dara, o kwuru, tinye ndị mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ ma 29 na efu.

rows.output: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ anwụ na mmebi ahụ nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu n'akụkụ osimiri 300 km (190 kilomita) n'ebe ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na-akpọ Donggala, nke dị nso na ebe mgbawa ahụ.
rows.reference: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ yana mmebi nwere ike ịkarị n’ogologo ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ 300km (maịlụ 190) n’akụkụ ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na akpọ Donggala, nke nọketere nso na etiti nke ọmajiji ahụ.

rows.output: Nkwurịta okwu "nwere nnukwu nsogbu na enweghị ozi ọ bụla" site na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: Nkwukọrịta enweghị ozi ọ bụla ma ncha sitere na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.

rows.output: Enwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 300,000 bi n'ebe ahụ," otu Red Cross kwuru n'okwu, na-ekwu na ndị ọrụ ha na ndị otu ha na-aga n'ebe a na-emetọ.
rows.reference: Enwere karịa ndị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ,” Red Cross kwuru na nkwupute, na etinye na ndị ọrụ ya na ndị wepụtara onwe ha na aga n’ebe ndị emetụtara.

rows.output: "Nke a bụ ihe na-akụda mmụọ, ma ọ ka nwere ike ime ka ọ ka njọ."
rows.reference: O kwuru “nke a abụrụla ihe mberede, mana ọ nwere ike ịkawanye njọ,”.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nwetara nkatọ na Satọde maka na ha emeghị ka ọ pụta ìhè na tsunami wakporo Palu, n'agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na ebili mmiri ahụ rutela n'oge a na-enye ịdọ aka ná ntị.
rows.reference: Ekwutọrọ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu na Satọde maka ịhapụ ikwu na tsunami dara na Palu, agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na nnukwu ikuku bịara n’oge enyere ịdọ aka na ntị ahụ.

rows.output: N'ime vidiyo nke ndị na-amu amu na-ekwupụta na mgbasa ozi ọha, otu nwoke n'elu ụlọ nwere ike ịnụ ka ọ na-akwa emo nchegbu banyere tsunami na-abịaru nso ka ọ na-ekwu okwu n'okporo ámá n'okpuru.
rows.reference: Na nseta ekekọrịtara n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze enwere ike ịnụ ka otu nwoke nọ n’elu ụlọ na eti nnukwu mkpu na adọ aka na ntị maka tsunami na abịa nke ọ na agwa ndị mmadụ n’okporo ụzọ dị n’okpuru.

rows.output: N'ime nkeji ole na ole, mgbidi nke mmiri na-ada n'ụsọ osimiri, na-eburu ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.
rows.reference: N’ime nkeji ole ma ole nnukwu mmiri dara n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, buru ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.

rows.output: Reuters enweghị ike ịkwado ihe onyonyo ahụ ozugbo.
rows.reference: Reuters enwenwughi ike inyocha nseta ahụ.

rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ na ebili mmiri ahụ kpatara nnukwu ọkụ eletrik nke bibiri nkwurịta okwu gburugburu Palu, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe isi ike nye ndị ọchịchị ka ha na-eme ihe n'ịnapụta.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ butere nnukwu mmebi n’ọkụ latrik nke gbubiri nkwukọrịta n’okirikiri Palu na eme ka ndị ikikere nwee nhịahụ na ịhazi mbọ ịzọpụta ndị mmadụ.

rows.output: Ndị agha amalitela iziga ụgbọ elu ibu na enyemaka sitere n'obodo Jakarta na ndị ọzọ, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị kwuru, mana ndị a na-azọpụta ka chọrọ nri na ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ebidola iziga ụgbọ elu eji ebu ibu bu ihe enyemaka sitere na Jakarta yana obodo ndị ọzọ, ndị ikikere kwuru, mana ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ka chọrọ nri na akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ eji ebi ndụ ngwangwa.

rows.output: Ụlọ ụgbọ elu obodo ahụ emegheela naanị maka mbọ enyemaka ma ka ga-emechi ruo Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Emepegharịala ọdụ ụgbọ elu nke obodo ahụ naanị maka mbọ ihe enyemaka, a ga-aga n’ihu mechie ya ruo Ọkt.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo bu n'eme atụmatụ ịga ụlọ mgbaba n'ọgba aghara na Palu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Joko Widodo kwesịrị ịbịa n’ama mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ndị dị na Palu na Sọnde.

rows.output: Mgbapụta Indonesia na-ebili n'elu 800.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ Tsunami Indonesia Agafeela 800.

rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ Jọrọ Oke Njọ.

rows.output: N'oge a, ndị ọrụ nke World Vision si Donggala erutela Palu n'udo, ebe ndị ọrụ na-eche nche n'ụlọikwuu tarpaulin e debere n'ogige ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha hụrụ ihe mgbapụta n'ụzọ ahụ, Maazị Doseba kwuru.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị ọrụ World Vision si Donggala garuru n’obodo Palu na enweghị nsogbu, ebe ndị ọrụ ya na anara ndo n’okpuru mkpuchi tapọlin atọlitere na mpụga nke ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha gafere okirikiri nke mbibi n’ụzọ ha, Maazị Doseba kwuru.

rows.output: "O kwuru na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ ndị e bibiri."
rows.reference: O kwuru “ha gwara m na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ emebiri,”.

rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ndị otu na-enyere aka malitere ihe isi ike nke ịmalite usoro enyemaka ihe mberede, ụfọdụ ndị na-ekwupụta na ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ọzọ nwere nnukwu ihe ọmụma na-egbochi ịga Palu.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi ka ndị otu enyemaka bidoro ọrụ nhịahụ nke ibido ụkwụ nke ihe enyemaka ọdachi, ụfọdụ kpesara na a na egbochi ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ofesi nwere nka dị mkpa na ịga na Palu.

rows.output: N'ime iwu ndị Indonesia, ego, ihe ndị a na-enye na ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịmalite ịbata ma ọ bụrụ na ebe ihe mberede ahụ dị ka mpaghara ihe mberede mba.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị iwu nke Indonesia, ego, ngwa na ndị ọrụ si na mba ofesi nwere naanị ike ibido ịga ma ọ bụrụ na akpọọ ebe nke mbibi ahụ ihe ogige ọdachi mba.

rows.output: Nke ahụ emebeghị.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ emebeghị.

rows.output: "Ọ ka bụ ihe mberede dị na ọkwa mpaghara," ka Aulia Arriani, onye na-ekwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ ka bụ ọdachi ọkwa ogige,” Aulia Arriani kwuru, onye okwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia.

rows.output: "Ozugbo gọọmentị kwuru, "Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ihe mberede mba," anyị nwere ike imeghe maka enyemaka mba ụwa mana ọ dịghị ọkwa."
rows.reference: “Ozugbo gọọmentị ahụ kwuru, “Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ọdachi mba,” anyị nwere ike imepe maka enyemaka ofesi mana enwebeghị ọkwa ọ bụla.”

rows.output: N'abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu mgbe ọtụtụ ndị na-efunahụ ihe na-atụ anya na ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ga-abụ ihe a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme ka akụkọ ndị na-adịghị mma nke ihe ndị sitere n'okike dị mma.
rows.reference: Ka abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu ka ala ọmajiji na tsunami nke Fraịde mechara, ndị enyi na ezinụlọ nke ndị ka na efu jidere okwukwe na ndị ha hụrụ n’anya ga-abụ ọrụ ebube na akpalite mmụọ nke akụkụ ọjọọ nke ọdachi ekereụwa.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, a kpọpụrụ nwa nwoke nọ n'ime mmiri mmiri.
rows.reference: Na Satọde, akpapụtara otu obere nwa n’ime olulu.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ndị na-azọpụta ndị gbawara agbawa napụtara nwanyị nke a na-akụ n'ime ihe ndị dara n'ụbọchị abụọ, n'akụkụ ahụ nke nne ya.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, ndị mgbata ọsọ enyemaka zọpụtara otu nwanyị nke akpadoro n’okpuru ahịhịa n’ime ụbọchị abụọ, n’akụkụ ya bụ ahụ nne ya.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, onye nkuzi ndị otu paragliding mba Indonesia, zụrụ ndị na-agba paragliding abụọ na-efunahụ maka egwuregwu Asia, nke mechara n'Indonesia.

rows.output: Greece, nke nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia, na-ekwu na aha ógbè ya na-anọchi anya ihe na-ekwu na ya, ma na-egbochi ya ịbata na NATO na EU.
rows.reference: Greece, nke nwere ogige akpọrọ Macedonia, na ekwusi ike na aha agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, o gbochiela mbanye ya na NATO yana EU.

rows.output: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ n'ọnwa Juun dabere na aha ọhụrụ a tụrụ aro, mana ndị na-emegide ọchịchị na-arụ ụka na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emebi njirimara agbụrụ nke ndị Slav na-achị Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ rutere nkwekọrịta na Juun dabere na aha ọhụrụ atụnyere, mana ndị iro bụ obodo n’isi na arụrịta ụka na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emebi njirimara agbụrụ nke ọnụọgụgụ ndị Slavic kachasị nke Macedonia.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwupụtala na ọ gaghị eme ntụliaka n'ọgbakọ ahụ ma otu ndị na-akwado ịkagbu ya ekwupụtala obi abụọ na ọ ga-enwe ọnụ ọgụgụ dị mkpa 50% maka ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ nke a na-anabata.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwuola na ọ gaghị atuli aka na nhọpụta ahụ, ọzọkwa mgbasa ozi mgbochi etinyela obi mgbagha ma ndị ga-apụta a ga-erukwa pasentị 50 achọrọ pekarịsịrị maka nhọpụta ahụ ịdị ire.

rows.output: Ajụjụ dị na votu ntuli aka bụ: "Ọ ga-amasị gị NATO na EU na nnabata nke nkwekọrịta na Gris."
rows.reference: Ajụjụ dị n’akwụkwọ nhọpụta ahụ gụrụ: “Ị kwụnyere nsonye NATO na EU site na ịnabata nkwekọrịta dị n’etiti Greece.”

rows.output: Ndị na-akwado mgbanwe aha, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-ekwu na ọ bụ ọnụ ahịa kwesịrị ịkwụ ụgwọ iji chụsoo nnabata n'ime òtù dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n'ime mba ndị pụtara n'ịda nke Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Ndị na akwado mgbanwe aha ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrịta ụka na ọ bụ ụgwọ ekwesịrị ịkwụ iji sochie nnabata n’ewumewu ndị dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n’ime obodo ndị pụtara n’ọdịda nke Yugoslavia.

rows.output: "Abịarutere taa ịtụ vootu maka ọdịnihu obodo ahụ, maka ndị na-eto eto na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi n'efu n'okpuru canopy nke European Union n'ihi na ọ pụtara ndụ dị nchebe nye anyị niile," ka Olivera Georgijevska, 79, kwuru na Skopje.
rows.reference: “Abịara m taa ituli aka maka ọdịnihu nke obodo anyị, maka ndị ntorobịa nọ na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi ndụ otu ha chọrọ n’okpuru nche nke European Union n’ihi ọ pụtara ndụ ka mma maka anyị niile,” nke Olivera Georgijevska kwuru, 79, na Skopje.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụghị iwu, ndị otu ụlọ omebe iwu zuru ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ga-akwado nsonaazụ ntuli aka ka ọ bụrụ nke na-ekwesị ekwesị.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọdịghị n’okpuru iwu, ndị otu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu zuru oke ekwuola na ha ga-asọpụrụ ndapụta nke ntuli aka ahụ iji mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị mkpa.

rows.output: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ọtụtụ ndị omebe iwu abụọ n'ụlọomeiwu.
rows.reference: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ụzọ abụọ n’ọkara ụzọ atọ nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu dị ukwuu.

rows.output: Kọmishọna ntuli aka steeti ahụ kwuru na ọ nweghị akụkọ banyere ihe na-adịghị mma n’elekere 1 nke ehihie.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ntuli aka steeti kwuru na enwebeghị mkpesa nke mpụ n’ebe 1 ehihie.

rows.output: Ọbụna, ntụliaka ahụ guzoro na naanị pasentị iri na isii, ma e jiri ya tụnyere pasentị iri atọ na anọ na ntuli aka ndị omebe iwu gara aga n'afọ 2016 mgbe pasentị iri isii na isii nke ndị debanyere aha ha mere ntụliaka ha.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mpụta dị naanị na pasentị 16, tụlee pasentị 34 na ntuli aka nzụkọ ọmeiwu gara aga na 2016 mgbe pasentị 66 nke ndị ntuli aka edebanyere n’akwụkwọ tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha.

rows.output: "Agara mụta ịtụ vootu n'ihi ụmụ m, ebe anyị nọ na Europe," Gjose Tanevski, 62, onye na votu n'isi obodo, Skopje, kwuru.
rows.reference: “Apụtara m ituli aka n’ihi ụmụaka m, ọnọdụ anyị bụ na Europe,” ka Gjose Tanevski kwuru, 62, onye ntuli aka n’isi ala, Skopje.
